description: qou-i9gk hole 1, settling Step 27's headline. The 'trace-blind sector' is the KERNEL of H_n(q) -> TL_n(q): omega_lambda = 0 <=> l(lambda) > 2 exactly at n = 3..8, and sum d^2 over <=2-row blocks = Catalan(n) at every n. Since TL_n = End_{U_q(sl2)}(V^(x)n), that kernel acts as ZERO on the N = 2 physical space — it IS the Schur-Weyl row cap, not a separate vanishing. Consequence: Step 27's 'hidden information' reading contradicts the convention it was measured in, because FibreCategoricalTraceForcesJones shows convention D is forced by exactly the premise (MassTraceIsFibreCategorical, open, bean qou-n1dj) that empties the blind sector. Under the premise there are no states there; under its negation D is not forced. Also: N_min(lambda) = l(lambda), so Step 27's 0.0252506 (in (3,2,1)) needs N >= 3 and its 0.0195531 (in (2,2,1,1)) needs N >= 4 — the 0.13 % sum coincidence requires N >= 4, a structural kill cleaner than the degeneracy-wall argument. What survives is that (3,2,1) is an l = 3 block carrying the largest binding character, so Step 27 measured what an N = 3 extension would carry — which is what qou-fvzm says the super-pairwise term requires.

assertions.name: blind_sector_is_the_TL_kernel_at_every_n
assertions.detail: omega_lambda = 0 <=> l(lambda) > 2 holds exactly at n = 3..8 with a clean gap (~1e-16 against 0.039..0.49), and sum d^2 over the <=2-row blocks equals Catalan(n) at every n (5,14,42,132,429,1430 against 3!..8!). So those blocks ARE TL_n and the rest span the kernel of H_n(q) -> TL_n(q) = End_{U_q(sl2)}(V^(x)n) — the Schur-Weyl row cap at N = 2, structurally rather than as an n = 6 accident

assertions.name: step27_reading_contradicts_the_convention_it_used
assertions.detail: `FibreCategoricalTraceForcesJones.lean` (bean qou-n1dj) proves that the l > 2 channels are absent at N = 2 and that y_(1^3) = 0 forces JONES, with one open premise between them: that the mass trace IS the categorical trace of the fibre action on V^(x)n. Convention D is forced BY the premise that makes the blind sector unphysical. Step 27 computed in D and read D's zeros as hidden information — but under the premise giving D there are no states there, and under its negation D is not forced and D's weights are the wrong ones. The reading fails either way as stated; what it reduces to is qou-n1dj

assertions.name: the_two_small_phases_need_N3_and_N4_respectively
assertions.detail: a block acquires states exactly when N reaches l(lambda). Step 27's 0.0252506 sits in (3,2,1) (l = 3, needs N >= 3) and its 0.0195531 in (2,2,1,1) (l = 4, needs N >= 4), so the 0.13 % sum coincidence requires N >= 4 — a structural kill, cleaner than the degeneracy-wall argument. The corpus has dim V = 2, N = 3 open (qou-8pl3), and nothing motivating N = 4

assertions.name: what_survives_is_a_measurement_of_an_N3_extension
assertions.detail: qou-fvzm says the super-pairwise binding term REQUIRES N >= 3 for row-cap reasons, and (3,2,1) — carrying both the largest binding character (-9.598) and the smaller of the two phases — is an l = 3 block. So Step 27 measured what an N = 3 extension would carry. That is weaker and different from what Step 27 claimed, and it is the part that survives
